description:
The Forward Deployed Engineer is the hands-on technical core and primary builder within a CDW Customer FDE Pod who is embedded with named customer accounts to design, build, deploy, and operate AI-enabled solutions in the customer's environment. Reporting to the FDE Lead and partnering with the Forward Deployed Strategist, the role turns complex customer problems into working production capabilities and accountable for technical solution quality, engineering execution, production readiness, and the technical measures within the engagement scorecard
 This role combines software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, and rapid problem-solving across CDW's AI Services Framework (AI Blueprint, AI Enable, AI Implement, AI Manage, and AI Secure). The Forward Deployed Engineer operates inside the customer's environment, writes production-grade code, connects systems and data, builds AI agents, MCP servers, and workflows on frontier AI platforms such as Anthropic and OpenAI, provides technical direction to global delivery resources who flex onto pod-defined builds, and hands solutions off cleanly to Global Managed Services. Between customer milestones, the role contributes field-proven patterns to the Lighthouse Pod and CDW's portfolio IP.
 What you will do
 Customer-Embedded Engineering and Pod Delivery 
 Embed with named customer accounts, as part of a dedicated enterprise pod or a shared pod serving 3–5 mid-market customers, and partner with the FDE Lead and Forward Deployed Strategist to understand business processes, technical environments, constraints, and desired outcomes.
 Translate ambiguous customer needs into technical requirements, solution designs, prototypes, and production implementations. 
 Own technical delivery from discovery through build, deployment, validation, and handoff to Global Managed Services to reduce handoffs and context loss.
 Communicate technical options, tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to customer and internal stakeholders. 
 AI Solution Design and Production Delivery 
 Design, build, test, and deploy production-grade enterprise AI applications, agents, sub-agents, skills, MCP servers, workflows, integrations, APIs, and data pipelines in the customer's environment.
 Develop production-quality software using modern engineering practices and cloud-native architectures. 
 Implement patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows where appropriate. 
 Integrate AI capabilities with customer systems, data sources, security controls, and operational processes. 
 Troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize solutions for reliability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost. 
 Delivery Leverage and Portfolio Contribution 
 Apply Lighthouse Pod reference implementations, accelerators, agent swarms, and tooling to accelerate customer delivery, and give candid field feedback on what works and what should change.
 Document architectures, code, configuration, implementation guidance, runbooks, and lessons learned so solutions can be operated by the customer and Global Managed Services, repeated, and scaled.
 Surface recurring customer patterns to the Lighthouse Pod, Product Managers, and the Director of AI Product so one-off solutions can be evaluated for standardization or productization.
 Contribute to shared technical standards, code-review practices, testing approaches, and responsible AI controls. 
 Technical Leadership and Collaboration 
 Collaborate with the FDE Lead, Forward Deployed Strategist, Lighthouse Pod, Field CTO, architects, security, data, cloud, and other CDW practices (for example, the AWS practice) where delivery overlaps.
 Evaluate emerging AI technologies and rapidly develop technical points of view through hands-on experimentation. 
 Share knowledge with engineering and delivery communities and support the adoption of validated tools and patterns. 
 Balance rapid iteration with enterprise-grade engineering discipline. 
 What we expect of you 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field and 7+ years of relevant experience OR 11+ years of relevant experience. 
 Hands-on software engineering experience with Python and modern application-development frameworks. 
 Experience designing and deploying cloud-based applications, APIs, integrations, or data pipelines in production environments. 
 Experience building AI-enabled applications using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, or comparable patterns. 
 Experience in a customer-facing delivery role (forward-deployed engineering, consulting, or professional services) working directly with customers to clarify needs and deliver technical solutions to production.
 Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, testing, source control, CI/CD, security, and operational reliability. 
 Experience leading technical workstreams and guiding other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing.
 Ability to travel as needed for on-site work in customer environments.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI , AWS , Google Cloud, or comparable AI platforms. 
 Experience with Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph , LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol, vector databases, or AI evaluation and observability tools. 
 Experience in forward-deployed engineering, technical consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, or startup product engineering. 
 Experience taking AI solutions from prototype to stable production and transitioning them to customer or managed-services operations teams.
 Experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and enterprise identity and security patterns. 
 Background in an enterprise vertical such as healthcare, financial services, government, or education.
 Pay range: $143,913 - $201,738 depending on experience and skill set
 Annual bonus target of 15% subject to terms and conditions of plan
 Benefits overview: https://cdw.benefit-info.com/
 Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials 
 
 CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization 
We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work. 
 Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.
 
 About Us 
 CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.
  
 As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.
 Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen. 
  
 CDW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by state and local law.
